headline: Get Thornblade
title: How to Get Thornblade in Aniimo | Budsquire Solo Fight Trick | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Thornblade has an odd evolution trick. Raise your Budsquire to level twenty seven. Then you must defeat a Thornblade using a party that has only that Budsquire in it. No teammates allowed. Wild Thornblade live in the Sea of Flowers, at around level nineteen to twenty eight, so it is a fair fight. Did you win the solo fight? Comment below!
description: Budsquire evolves into Thornblade at level 27 after you defeat a Thornblade with a party containing only that Budsquire; wild Thornblade are in the Sea of Flowers.
